description: This file contains the UtilNumber class, which provides utility functions for number formatting, locale-specific rules for monetary amounts, handling BigDecimal properties, and other numerical operations in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilNumber
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for number formatting, locale-based rule formatting, BigDecimal configuration, and number operations.

methods.name: getBigDecimalScale
methods.description: Retrieves the scale for BigDecimal operations from properties, defaulting to 2 if not specified.

methods.name: getBigDecimalScale
methods.description: Overloaded method that retrieves the BigDecimal scale from the default 'arithmetic.properties' file.

methods.name: getBigDecimalRoundingMode
methods.description: Deprecated method to get rounding mode as an integer from properties.

methods.name: getBigDecimalRoundingMode
methods.description: Deprecated method to get rounding mode as an integer from properties in the default properties file.

methods.name: getRoundingMode
methods.description: Retrieves the RoundingMode object from properties, defaults to RoundingMode.HALF_UP.

methods.name: getRoundingMode
methods.description: Overloaded method that retrieves the RoundingMode based on property name from the default properties file.

methods.name: roundingModeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string representation of a rounding mode to the corresponding RoundingMode enum.

methods.name: formatRuleBasedAmount
methods.description: Formats a monetary amount into words according to the locale's rule set (e.g., for checks).

methods.name: formatRuleBasedAmount
methods.description: Formats a monetary amount using a specified ICU4J rule set and rule name.

methods.name: toPercentString
methods.description: Deprecated method that formats a Number into a percentage string with specified scale and rounding mode (as int).

methods.name: toPercentString
methods.description: Formats a Number into a percentage string with specified scale and RoundingMode object.

methods.name: safeAdd
methods.description: Adds two BigDecimal numbers safely, considering null for the right operand.

methods.name: getBigDecimal
methods.description: Resolves a BigDecimal value from a context map for a specific field, with a default fallback.
